tools.name: townhouse_check_availability
tools.description: Check whether the townhouse is open for specific dates. Returns available true/false, any blocked nights in the range, and the minimum stay.

tools.name: townhouse_get_calendar
tools.description: List open and blocked nights for a date window (up to 120 days). Use this when the traveler has flexible dates. A night is the date the guest sleeps there.

tools.name: townhouse_get_quote
tools.description: Exact price for a stay: nightly rates by season, cleaning fee, pet fee, total, deposit, and an estimate of what the same stay costs on Airbnb. Also confirms the dates are open.

tools.name: townhouse_get_property_info
tools.description: Facts about the townhouse: capacity, rooms, amenities, location and ski access, check-in and check-out times, and policies. Fields the owner has not published are null; do not guess them.

tools.name: townhouse_get_photos
tools.description: Photo URLs with a description of what each shows. Category "area" is scenery near the townhouse, not the townhouse itself (shows_the_property is false).

tools.name: townhouse_request_booking
tools.description: Submit a booking request for the traveler. Only call this after the traveler has seen the quote and approved sending the request. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: townhouse_get_photos · Private data: townhouse_request_booking · Public sink: townhouse_request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: townhouse_get_photos · Private data: townhouse_request_booking · Public sink: townhouse_request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
